title: Obstacle Definition Schema
description: Canonical obstacle object definition. This is the single obstacle contract: it uses the object-catalog vocabulary (object_id/label/category/movable/stackable/movement) that the map runtime already consumes. The former obstacle_id/obstacle_type/movement shape has been retired so obstacles have exactly one canonical form.

object_id.description: Stable machine-readable canonical obstacle identifier slug (lowercase, digits, single separators).

label.description: Human-friendly name shown on the map UI.

description.description: Human-readable description focused on gameplay implications (movement, combat, interaction).

movable.description: Whether the object can be moved (pushed/lifted/rearranged) by entities.

stackable.description: Whether multiple instances can share a hex.

passable.description: If true, occupants can share the hex without obstruction.

blocks_movement.description: If true, pathfinding treats this hex as blocked unless interacted with.

cost_multiplier.description: Movement cost multiplier for entering this hex (1 = normal, 2 = difficult terrain, 999 = effectively impassable).

tags.description: Optional semantic tags for filtering and UI chips.

size.description: Optional PF2e size category for the obstacle.

weight.description: Optional PF2e Bulk value indicating weight/portability. 'L' for light bulk, numeric values for standard bulk.

orientation.description: Optional facing of the obstacle on the map, as an eight-point compass direction.

interaction.description: Optional interaction mechanics for this obstacle object.

can_open.description: Whether this obstacle can be opened (e.g., doors, chests, windows).

can_close.description: Whether this obstacle can be closed after being opened.

requires_key.description: Whether opening requires a specific key or item.

athletics_dc.description: Optional Athletics DC to force open, break, or move the obstacle.

thievery_dc.description: Optional Thievery DC to pick a lock or disable a mechanism.

visual.description: Optional visual representation metadata for rendering. Enumerated and strict so the definition editor can render every field.

sprite_id.description: Identifier for the visual sprite or asset to render this obstacle.

color.description: Hex color code for tinting or theming the obstacle.

rotation.description: Default rotation in degrees (0-359) for oriented obstacles.

orientation.description: Optional visual facing hint as an eight-point compass direction.

prompt.description: Optional original image-generation prompt used to produce this obstacle's sprite.
